criteria: Through the authenticated public API, create a Project with an inline organization Resource; edit and replay exact idempotency keys; detach and reattach the Resource; delete it while attached; verify organization/Project fences, ownership/tombstone, exact receipts, activities, outbox, byte-identical replay response, and unchanged post-replay rows. Missing credentials and a cross-organization agent must be rejected before writes.

Through the authenticated public Chat API, retain the Node-owned non-branding proposal path with its audit/system event and no Rust branding receipt; reject same-org non-CEO and cross-org CEO proposals with 403 and unchanged state/side effects across target and agent organizations; approve a fresh Node-owned branding proposal as board admin and verify one Node-to-Rust owner/fence transition, receipt, activity, outbox, and Chat operation-applied event.

Run the built first-party CLI org brand-color update command against the real API, then run the built stdio MCP server through initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, and tools/call using the same org, payload, and idempotency key. Both surfaces return the expected result; SQL readback proves Rust ownership and exactly one receipt, linked activity, and outbox row after cross-transport replay. Exercise supported logo/color clear and invalid-logo behavior.

Force a Rust audit-side-effect failure, then retry the identical request with the original idempotency key and payload; require one applied receipt, linked activity, and outbox row, then replay the same request and verify the response and effect rows are unchanged. For outbox recovery, delay a real receipt-linked Rust event in the disposable database, restart the server, make it eligible, and verify it reaches published with the same receipt/activity/outbox IDs and payload. The existing publisher is retryable at-least-once with a stable outbox-ID dedupe key; this criterion does not claim exactly-once network delivery.

Scope is a private real-entry bridge slice. It does not claim installed/default public Rust ingress, retirement of all first-party Node authorities, complete Chat/Side Chat migration, implementation completion, release readiness, or production verification.
state_inventory: Resource public API: missing credential/cross-org denial; create with inline Resource; edit/replay; attachment edit/detach/replay; reattach; attached delete/replay with exact owner/fence/effect readback.

Chat public API: Node-owned non-branding approval remains intact; non-CEO and foreign-organization CEO denial preserve pending proposal and all side-effect tables; authorized fresh branding proposal performs one ownership handoff and preserves proposal/history/audit semantics.

CLI/MCP: CLI update followed by full stdio MCP protocol lifecycle using the same idempotency key; compare database snapshot before/after replay; exercise supported logo/color updates and negative logo paths.

Recovery: failed audit write is retried with the identical key and payload and creates one receipt-linked effect set; a real pending receipt-linked event survives restart and is published with stable identity under retryable at-least-once delivery semantics.
Deferred: installed UI/default ingress, full Node backend exit, all other Chat/Side Chat capabilities, release gates, production cutover.
